page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Hardware capability flags indicate that advanced instruction sets are unavailable on this instance. This includes the absence of Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography standards such as AES and SHA_NI. Additionally, virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM) and hyper-threading (HT) flags are not exposed to the guest operating system.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is configured for memory-optimized workloads that do not require heavy parallel processing or advanced vector instructions. It is suitable for lightweight database caching, small-scale in-memory data structures, and general-purpose applications requiring a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable performance for memory-bound tasks without the overhead of unused local storage or GPU hardware.
